# Slovey

> Slovey is an engineering-decision memory and a pre-commit gate for AI coding
> agents. It records why a team made each technical decision, then checks every
> AI-generated change against that record before the change is committed —
> blocking work that contradicts a decision the team already made.

Slovey sits between the coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI)
and the repository. Agents keep writing code as they do today; Slovey reviews
what they produce.

The problem it addresses: rule files such as CLAUDE.md or Cursor rules are
prose. They drift as the codebase changes, and nothing enforces them — the
agent decides whether to comply. So agents re-make decisions that were already
rejected: reintroducing a retry path removed after an incident, or contradicting
an architecture decision made months earlier.

## How it works

- **Engineering Decision Graph**: decisions are stored as structured records
  ("we use X, we rejected Y, because Z") rather than prose, so they can be
  queried and enforced instead of merely read.
- **Pre-commit preflight**: every change runs build, then tests, then checks
  against recorded decisions, team conventions, and deprecated patterns.
- **Blocking with citation**: a violating change is blocked and the specific
  decision that made the rule is cited back to the agent.
- **Agent access**: agents connect over an MCP server or a REST API, so the
  decision graph is queryable mid-session, before code is written.

## What it is not

- Not a replacement for Claude Code, Cursor, or any coding agent — it reviews
  their output rather than generating code itself.
- Not a general-purpose agent memory API (mem0, Zep). Those provide recall for
  developers building agents; Slovey is enforcement for coding agents — a gate
  that inspects the change itself.

## Status

Independent, solo-built, and open source under the MIT license. Publicly
launched in 2026 with no paying customers yet; the blocked-change examples shown
on the site come from Slovey gating its own repository and its author's other
projects.

## Install

Free tier covers one repository and requires no payment card:

```
npm i -g slovey
```

## Pricing

- Starter — $0/forever: 1 repository, pre-commit review, basic decision graph.
- Team — $19/user/month billed annually: unlimited repositories, full decision
  graph, rule enforcement, MCP server and API access.
- Enterprise — custom: self-hosted/VPC, SSO, SCIM, audit logs.

- [MCP server](https://slovey.dev/mcp): connecting Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents.
- [API reference](https://slovey.dev/api-reference): REST endpoints for the decision graph.
- [Integrations](https://slovey.dev/integrations): GitHub, Slack, Notion, Jira, Linear, Confluence.
- [Security](https://slovey.dev/security): where code and decision data are processed and stored.
